dataAgentConfiguration.name: LegalFirmRoutingAgent
dataAgentConfiguration.description: Two-source routing exercise for standard semantic-model questions and prepared Lakehouse analysis scenarios.

dataSources.name: LegalFirmOptimized
dataSources.description: Use for standard customer, case, solicitor, transaction, and interaction questions. Prefer explicit model measures for customer counts, case counts and values, revenue, payments, expenses, billed hours, and unpaid invoices.
routingTopics: case counts, status, type, and value
solicitor details and ordinary case analysis
revenue, payments, expenses, billed hours, and unpaid invoices
dataSources.notes: Data Agent example question/query pairs are not supported for Power BI semantic-model sources. Use model descriptions, Prep for AI, and agent instructions instead.

dataSources.name: LegalFirmDemo
dataSources.description: Use only for engagement segments, questions combining case context with financial outcomes, payment-risk analysis, and solicitor performance tiers.
routingTopics: customer engagement segments and interaction recency
combined case-finance outcomes and outstanding balances

exampleQueries.question: Which customers are in the low engagement segment?
exampleQueries.query: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, total_interactions, last_interaction_date FROM step6_client_engagement_summary WHERE engagement_segment = 'Low Engagement' ORDER BY customer_name

exampleQueries.question: Which high-value open cases have outstanding balances?
exampleQueries.query: SELECT case_id, solicitor_name, case_value_gbp, outstanding_amount_gbp FROM step6_case_finance_insights WHERE case_status = 'Open' AND case_value_gbp >= 100000 AND outstanding_amount_gbp > 0 ORDER BY outstanding_amount_gbp DESC

exampleQueries.question: Which solicitors are in the top performance tier?
exampleQueries.query: SELECT solicitor_name, cases_handled, total_case_value_gbp FROM step6_solicitor_performance_mart WHERE performance_tier = 'Top' ORDER BY total_case_value_gbp DESC

dataAgentConfiguration.agentInstructions: Use LegalFirmOptimized for ordinary customer, case, solicitor, transaction, and interaction questions that can be answered by model fields or measures. Use LegalFirmDemo only for engagement segments, combined case-finance outcomes, payment risk, outstanding balances by case, or solicitor performance tiers. Prefer one source when the question is clear. Do not combine sources unless the requested result cannot be answered by one selected source.

routingScenarios.question: How many active customers do we have?
Which customers are in the low engagement segment?
Which high-value open cases have outstanding balances?
Which solicitors are in the top performance tier?
